18 open-source Corsair projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Corsair peripherals and iCUE. 11 of 18 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: ckb-next, liquidctl, HeadsetControl, OpenLinkHub, OpenCorsairLink.

  • Peripherals & Gaming Hardware · 16
  • Audio · 1
  • Headsets, Audio Interfaces & Webcams · 1

  1. ckb-next★ 3,713 · active · C++

    Open-source driver for Corsair keyboards and mice

  2. liquidctl★ 2,707 · active · Python

    Cross-platform tool for controlling AIO coolers, fans and RGB from NZXT, Corsair and others

  3. HeadsetControl★ 1,966 · active · C++

    Control features of Logitech, SteelSeries, Corsair and other USB headsets on Linux/macOS

  4. OpenLinkHub★ 1,270 · active · Go

  7. FanControl.CorsairLink★ 299 · active · C#

  8. rcue★ 60 · slowing · Rust

  10. CorsairLinkPlusPlus★ 57 · archived · C#

  11. corsairmi★ 55 · slowing · C

  14. corsairpsu★ 37 · active · C

  15. corsair-xeneon-edge-linux★ 20 · active · C++

  16. CorsairK95★ 16 · dormant · NSIS

  17. corsair-re★ 15 · dormant · C

  18. corsair-void-driver★ 6 · active · C
